scope: Pinned app real Camera/ScanScreen._run/LivePreviewThread rendering; only physical display/buttons and full Screen construction substituted

diagnosticDependencyOverlay.scope: Isolated board PYTHONPATH dependencies used because the old rootfs differs from the intended image; final image pins pycryptodomex3.23 and is separately built/checked.

limits: Actual pinned ScanScreen._run,LivePreviewThread and _render_preview_frame execute with actual Camera and nativeQR backend; actual app fonts/resources load.
Full BaseScreen constructor/hardware Renderer/buttons are replaced only at headless display/software cancel boundaries. This is not a physical LCD/button test.
Settings.RUNTIME_PROFILE is explicitly overridden to luckfox_22; device-tree runtime-profile autodetection remains outside this check.
The existing physical public QR is clipped. All8decode attempts return FALSE and timedcancel succeeds; no optical scan success is claimed.
Decode/render counts are actual loop iterations, not a unique-frame throughput benchmark.
The backend publishes its explicit fixed640x480 RGB native stream despite upstream480x480/6FPS/BGR/legacyV4L2 requests. Requested settings and ignored legacy device remain visible in backendInfo.
Old-rootfs diagnostic dependencies differ from finalimage; this does not prove the final rootfs boots.
